claims.text: The same 5 August 1947 report gives estimated man-days of work performed on Project RAND during June 1947 as: military personnel 30, civilian 10, contractor's personnel RAND proper 2,200 and RAND subcontractors 1,400, total 3,600 -- so contractor effort was roughly ninety times government effort at the point RAND was still inside Douglas Aircraft.

A report headed 'Report on Evaluation of Military Worth Activities (Reports Control Symbol WDCSO-(OT)-50)', Operations Analysis AC/AS-3, dated 5 August 1947 and directed to the Deputy Chief of Air Staff for Research and Development, states that 'The principal AAF activity in this particular field is Project RAND (AAF Project MX-791).'
